title: Star generator (seeded galaxy layout)
description: Generate the galaxy's star list deterministically from GALAXY_SEED: N stars with id, name, spectral class, galactic coordinates, and system count. Identical for every client and run.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/shared/galaxy/stars.ts` exports `generateStars(seed: string, count?: number): Star[]` with Star = { id: string (deterministic hash), name: string, class: 'O'|'B'|'A'|'F'|'G'|'K'|'M', x: number, y: number, z: number (galactic units, disk distribution), systemCount: number }
Names are unique within the galaxy and drawn from a seeded word-list combiner (prefix+root+suffix) so the same seed always yields the same name
Golden snapshot test: generateStars('drift-dev-seed-001') deep-equals a committed JSON fixture (first 25 stars + full length + checksum field)
Unit tests: determinism (two calls equal), name uniqueness, class distribution roughly matches spectral weighting (O rare, K/M common)

steps.details: In src/shared/galaxy/types.ts define Star, SystemSummary, Planet, SurfaceChunk interfaces (extend in later tasks). In src/shared/galaxy/config.ts: GALAXY_STAR_COUNT=200, spectral class weights, name word lists (prefix/root/suffix arrays, 40+ entries each).

Use Rng(seedFromString(seed)). For each star i: sub-seed = hash2(masterSeed, i); position = galactic disk (radius ~ log-normal, thin z), class = weighted pick, name = combine(sub-seed), systemCount = 2..8 (seeded), id = hex of sub-seed. No side effects, no sorting by wall-clock.

Generate once and commit `src/shared/galaxy/__fixtures__/stars-dev-seed.json` (first 25 stars, total length, sha256 of canonical JSON of all stars). Test regenerates and compares; a mutation in the generator fails the test.
Test with 5 different seeds: determinism, unique ids, unique names, coordinate bounds, systemCount range. Run `npm run test` + `npm run typecheck`.

technicalNotes: Star.id is the stable key referenced by system generation (TASK-4) and by system_id in the DB (system_registry).
Canonical JSON = stable key order (write a small canonicalize helper in shared) so the checksum is platform-stable.
